jobs.description:
International company in Brussels. 

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for an Administrative Assistant with over 2 years of experience in administration for our client.

What are your tasks?

• Keep agendas up-to-date and ensure consistency amongst Executives’ activities
• Follow-up meetings/conferences/registrations and invitation to meetings/conferences etc.
• Arrange travel plans (flights, hotel reservations etc.).
• Format documents and send e-mail/letters
• Assist with the preparation and the formatting of presentations (PowerPoint)
• Keep our SharePoint up-to-date with meeting materials etc.
• Keep our contact database up to date
• Follow up of contracts with external parties and ensure their appropriate recording in the contract database.
• Collecting and providing all relevant information for internal/external meetings
• Sending outlook invitations and tracking replies
• Gathering working documents, preparing meeting folders and checking presentations’ accuracy
• Organizing Microsoft Teams meetings when relevant
• Ordering lunches
• Setting up meeting rooms for calls and face to face meetings
• Answer phone calls and welcome visitors

Skills & Competences:

• You possess a degree/diploma/certificate in Administration or relevant
• At least 2 years of experience
• Past experience of working in an international environment is an asset
• Excellent spoken and written in English, dutch and french is a prerequisite
• Excellent computer skills (Word, PowerPoint, Excel…)
• Team worker
• Being proactive
• Good oral and written communication abilities
• Flexible, diplomatic, with good cultural sensitivity o Independent and autonomous
• Eager to learn
• Able to respect deadlines and tight timing

Our distinguished firm, with a team of 900 advisors across the Benelux, Switzerland, and global financial centers, serves as the preferred legal and tax partner for businesses in the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, and Switzerland.

Clients benefit from personalized counsel, leveraging our full-service approach, sector-specific expertise, and extensive market knowledge.

Jobomschrijving

What will be your responsibilities?

• Facilitate the incorporation of new clients and commencement of matters.
• Aid in the arrangement and subsequent follow-up of invoicing procedures.
• Supervise the adherence to Know Your Client (KYC) identification protocols.
• Track and ensure compliance with Bar points.
• Handle document archiving, uphold database accuracy, and manage printing responsibilities.
• Deliver comprehensive administrative assistance, encompassing the creation of PowerPoint presentations, coordinating travel logistics, and overseeing timesheet management.
• Effectively organize schedules, arrange appointments with clients and colleagues, and manage logistics for recruitment interviews.
• Serve as a substitute for other administrative assistants when necessary.

can you recognise yourself in this?

• Demonstrate a proficient command of English and possess a solid passive understanding of either Dutch or French.
• Hold a high school diploma, a bachelor's degree (although not obligatory), or can present equivalent work experience.
• Exhibit a comprehensive understanding of MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Display an inclination for financial and billing systems, expressing a genuine enjoyment of numerical work.
• Showcase robust organizational skills, characterized by a high degree of structure and the ability to effectively prioritize tasks.
• Set yourself apart through precision, accuracy, and a commitment to thoroughness in your work.
• Proactively approach tasks with a customer-centric and service-oriented mindset.
• Flourish in a collaborative team-oriented environment.

We're looking for an IT Coordinator to play a key role in a fast-evolving Benelux environment. You'll combine hands-on IT expertise with project leadership, supporting critical business systems while driving strategic initiatives across ERP, e-commerce, cloud, and business applications.

Jobomschrijving

• Drive local and international IT projects, including ERP and digital platform transformations.
• Support and optimize business-critical applications such as ERP, e-commerce, CRM, and customer support tools.
• Act as the go-to expert for users, system integrations, and operational excellence.
• Ensure IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection remain robust and future-ready.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external technology partners to deliver seamless digital experiences.

• 5  years of experience in IT systems, applications, or project management.
• Strong ERP expertise; SAP experience is a major plus.
• Knowledge of e-commerce platforms (Shopify is a bonus).
• Broad understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud services, and user support.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French is an asset.

Our client is a well-established international player in the fashion industry, renowned for its creativity, quality, and commitment to excellence. Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where innovation, collaboration, and passion for fashion drive success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Personal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage and organize daily schedules, appointments, and meetings of the CEO, both professional and personal.
• Prepare and handle confidential documentation.
• Be a first point of contact for the CEO, answer calls and emails.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries.
• Act as a point of contact between internal teams and external stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized filing system for important documents and records.

A successful Personal Assistant should have:

• Proven experience in administrative roles (3  years preferred, with a minimum of 2).
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
• Proficiency in using office software and tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English and preferably French or Dutch.
• A proactive and detail-oriented approach to work.

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Our client is one of the world's leading specialist HR consultancies. Help candidates build meaningful careers and support businesses in finding the talent they need to succeed. Joining the Brussels office means becoming part of a high-performing, collaborative team where entrepreneurship, development, and achievement are celebrated every day.

Jobomschrijving

• Developing and managing your own portfolio of clients within your specialist market.
• Identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing partnerships.
• Advising clients on recruitment strategies, salary benchmarks, and talent market trends.
• Sourcing, screening, and interviewing qualified candidates.
• Guiding candidates throughout the recruitment process and supporting them in their career development.
• Matching top talent with suitable opportunities.
• Negotiating offers and managing placements from start to finish.
• Achieving individual and team targets within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment.
•  

• Bachelor's or Master's degree holders.
• Passionate about people, business, and career development.
• Strong communicators with excellent interpersonal skills.
• Commercially minded, ambitious, and results-driven.
• Resilient and proactive, with a positive attitude and a desire to succeed.
• Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
• Fluent in English and Dutch and/or French.

Leading a team of three, you will ensure the smooth running of the procure-to-pay cycle, support internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements that contribute to stronger controls and faster supplier payments.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will manage the purchase order administration function and ensure the quality, accuracy and efficiency of related financial processes.

• Lead and support a team of three responsible for purchase order administration activities.
• Ensure purchase orders are created accurately and processed in line with internal procedures.
• Oversee supplier master data management, ensuring vendor information and bank details remain accurate and compliant.
• Maintain product catalogues and ensure pricing, descriptions and accounting information are up to date.
• Act as a key support partner for internal stakeholders, providing guidance on purchase order and supplier administration processes.
• Ensure compliance with approval workflows, financial controls and procure-to-pay procedures.
• Drive process improvements that enhance efficiency and support faster supplier payments.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in Accounts Payable, Accounting, Finance Operations or a similar environment.
• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
• Experience leading a team, or the ambition to take the next step from Team Lead to Manager.
• Strong understanding of procure-to-pay processes, purchase orders and supplier data management.
• Hands-on SAP experience is essential.
• A structured and detail-oriented professional with a strong focus on accuracy, controls and process efficiency.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.
• Drive process improvements, strengthen controls and support systems-related initiatives.
• Lead, coach and develop a small team, fostering collaboration and high performance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Solid accounting background with at least 7 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills - French and Dutch
• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.
• Strong business partnering mindset and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of SAP; experience with ERP implementations or system improvements is highly valued.

Our client is an EU organization based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage administrative mailboxes and general office correspondence.
• Register and review invoices while maintaining accurate supplier records.
• Prepare payments and support budget and expense management activities.
• Liaise with external accountants and maintain accounting documentation.
• Manage membership fees, donations and other contributions.
• Monitor contracts, deadlines, renewals and procurement procedures.
• Prepare and maintain administrative and financial reports, trackers and overviews.
• Review project documentation to ensure contracts, invoices and supporting documents are complete and properly filed.
• Support the preparation of documentation for audits, compliance reviews and public authorities.
• Coordinate office suppliers, equipment, inventory and external service providers.
• Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
• Maintain well-organised administrative records and contribute to the improvement of internal procedures and workflows.
• Provide general administrative, operational and compliance support as required.

• Minimum 1-2 years of experience in administration, office management or accounting support.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Good command of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Reliable, proactive and solution-oriented approach.

jobs.occupation: Relationship Support Associate - 6 months contract - M/F/X
jobs.description:
The Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) role involves supporting corporate banking processes with precision and efficiency. This position requires a strong command of English and attention to detail to ensure effective operations.

Client Details

The company operates in the financial services industry and is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking), your responsibilities are:

• Manage and process corporate banking transactions accurately and on time.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate with internal teams to resolve operational issues effectively.
• Monitor and report on operational performance metrics.
• Support the implementation of process improvements to enhance efficiency.
• Maintain accurate records and documentation for all transactions.
• Assist in the preparation of operational reports and analyses.
• Provide support for audits and other compliance activities.Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking)

A successful Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) should have:

• A strong command of English, both written and spoken.
• Bachelor or Master degree, preferably in finance or similar.
• Experience or knowledge in the financial services industry.
• Proficiency in using banking systems and tools.
• The ability to work collaboratively with internal teams.
• A commitment to maintaining compliance and operational accuracy.
• Applicants must already be based in Belgium and possess valid authorization to work in Belgium at the time of application.

Our client is a renowned international law firm with offices in Brussels.

• Managing complex calendars, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments.

• Drafting, formatting, editing, and finalising legal and business documents.

Our client is seeking an experienced Customer Service Manager to oversee customer service operations, drive continuous improvement, and lead a high-performing team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service Manager your responsibilities are:

• Lead and manage the customer service team to ensure high performance and efficiency.
• Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.
• Monitor and improve operational processes to ensure seamless service delivery.
• Handle escalated customer issues and provide effective resolutions.
• Analyse customer feedback and data to identify areas for improvement.
• Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards.
• Collaborate with other departments to align customer service goals with overall business objectives.
• Prepare and present reports on customer service performance to senior management.

A successful Customer Service Manager should have:

• Master's degree or equivalent higher education qualification
• Minimum 10 years of experience within an industrial or manufacturing environment
• At least 5 years of leadership experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations or Business Management
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English 
• Experience in exposure to executive leadership and cross-functional decision-making
• Strong background in change management and organizational transformation
• Experience working in complex international B2B environments

For an international and multicultural organisation based in Brussels, we are looking for an Administrative & Events Assistant to join their team.

In this role, you will be responsible for a variety of administrative and organisational tasks, while also supporting the organisation of events and activities.

 

Your responsibilities as Administrative and Events Assistant :

• Managing the general mailbox and forwarding requests to the relevant person
• Managing and organising documents through SharePoint, Teams and physical archives
• Providing administrative support to the team and ongoing projects
• Maintaining the annual calendar and keeping track of activities
• Supporting the preparation of subsidy applications
• Following up on memberships, sponsors and partners in collaboration with the accounting team
• Supporting the organisation of events: contacting venues, caterers and suppliers, requesting quotations and coordinating practical details
• Preparing meetings and ensuring everything is organised and running smoothly

Your profile as Administrative and Events Assistant : 

• Has a first experience in administration, or is a recent graduate looking to develop their experience
• Is organised, proactive and hands-on
• Is able to work independently and take initiative
• Has good common sense and a strong sense of responsibility
• Is discreet and understands the importance of confidentiality
• Enjoys organising events and making sure everything is taken care of
• Is comfortable working in a multicultural environment
• Has a very good command of English; French and Dutch are a strong asset
• Has a driving licence

As a Bilingual Accountant in the public sector, you will manage financial operations AZ and ensure compliance with relevant regulations. This position offers a variety of responsibilities and benefits for a skilled professional in accounting and finance.

Client Details

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Description

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.
• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.
• Reconcile bank statements and monitor cash flow activities.
• Prepare and submit tax declarations and other regulatory filings.
• Provide financial insights and support decision-making processes.

A successful Bilingual Accountant should have:

• Proficiency in accounting principles and financial reporting.
• Strong knowledge of Winbooks.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Strong knowledge of public sector financial regulations.
• Residence in Brussels.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Experience at least 1 year in accounting.
• Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines efficiently.

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.
